verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS formation platform with a dashboard, API, SDK, and MCP server, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a telemetry, analytics, or usage-tracking opt-out. The registered-agent address shielding and the 'commitment to privacy protection' line cover a different privacy feature and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
